设计意图： Mutation of qualified crossover candidate: removed the leverage penalty (debt ratio multiplier) from the large-cap earnings yield z-score component to simplify the mechanism and reduce potential noise. The small-cap side retains the leverage adjustment as it is a direct valuation ratio. The size-adaptive sigmoid blend remains. The cross-sectional rank post-transform is retained to enhance cross-se

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

Small: (1/pb_pos)*(1-debt/assets); Large: cs_zscore(1/pe, 126); blend via sigmoid(size_rank)

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

Small: (1/pb_pos)*(1-debt/assets); Large: cs_zscore(1/pe, 126); blend via sigmoid(size_rank)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. if_else —— 条件选择
    if_else((ts_mean(Volume, 20) < ts_mean(Volume, 60)), multiply(divide(1, pb_lf), subtract(1, divide(debttoassets, 100))), ts_zscore(divide(1, pe_ttm), 126))
  2. 2. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 20)
  3. 3. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 60)
  4. 4. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(divide(1, pb_lf), subtract(1, divide(debttoassets, 100)))
  5. 5. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(1, pb_lf)
  6. 6. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(1, divide(debttoassets, 100))
  7. 7. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(debttoassets, 100)
  8. 8. ts_zscore —— 滚动 Z-Score(标准化)
    ts_zscore(divide(1, pe_ttm), 126)
  9. 9. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(1, pe_ttm)
使用字段：
列含义说明

debttoassetsdebttoassets（中间变量/衍生量）
pb_lfpb_lf（中间变量/衍生量）
pe_ttmpe_ttm（中间变量/衍生量）

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
if_else条件选择：condition 为真返回 v1，否则返回 v2
ts_zscoren 期滚动 Z-Score：(x − 均值) / 标准差

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 size_rank：mkt_cap_float.滚动窗口(252, min_periods=60).rank(pct=True)
  2. 计算 w_large：1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-10.0 * (size_rank - 0.5)))
  3. 计算 w_small：1.0 - w_large
  4. 计算 pb_pos：pb_lf.where(pb_lf > 0, 空)
  5. 计算 book_yield：1.0 / pb_pos
  6. 计算 debt_ratio：debttoassets / 100.0
  7. 计算 small_val：book_yield * (1.0 - debt_ratio)
  8. 计算 pe_pos：pe_ttm.where(pe_ttm > 0, 空)
  9. 计算 earnings_yield：1.0 / pe_pos
  10. 计算 mean_ey：earnings_yield.滚动窗口(126, min_periods=63).mean()
  11. 计算 std_ey：earnings_yield.滚动窗口(126, min_periods=63).std(ddof=1)
  12. 计算 zscore_ey：(earnings_yield - mean_ey) / std_ey
  13. 计算 factor：w_small * small_val + w_large * large_val
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_size_adaptive_ey_zscore_no_large_lev(df): df_copy = df.copy() size_rank = df_copy["mkt_cap_float"].rolling(252, min_periods=60).rank(pct="kw">class="kw">True) w_large = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-10.0 * (size_rank - 0.5))) w_small = 1.0 - w_large "com"># small cap: book yield with leverage penalty pb_pos = df_copy["pb_lf"].where(df_copy["pb_lf"] > 0, np.nan) book_yield = 1.0 / pb_pos debt_ratio = df_copy["debttoassets"] / 100.0 small_val = book_yield * (1.0 - debt_ratio) "com"># large cap: earnings yield time-series z-score (no leverage penalty) pe_pos = df_copy["pe_ttm"].where(df_copy["pe_ttm"] > 0, np.nan) earnings_yield = 1.0 / pe_pos mean_ey = earnings_yield.rolling(126, min_periods=63).mean() std_ey = earnings_yield.rolling(126, min_periods=63).std(ddof=1) zscore_ey = (earnings_yield - mean_ey) / std_ey.replace(0, np.nan) large_val = zscore_ey factor = w_small * small_val + w_large * large_val df_copy["factor_size_adaptive_ey_zscore_no_large_lev"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_size_adaptive_ey_zscore_no_large_lev"]
